title: Rabbiinu essereh yan Amoytiinu
intro: caylaleeh kaxxiina le miraaca ken qarkaytoh dagal num soole waam yaamine. oson kudah butta fidin leeh amol diiriyen, dubuk diraamaatik ellecabo garayoonuh. Tama Amoytiini aydaadi Qur'aanak mango exxaaxil qagaaqagitak, inkih yan marah takkaawisso abak geytima.
clues: Anu caylale miraacak sugeeh, anu miraacisak suge baaxooxal uli reeda yi reeda matana axcuk yaamineh suge.
Anu aamanti liyo waziyer migaq Haman usuk yoo cateh quukah kaxxa xisô cugaysoosa.
Anu inni baaxok meqe baab abeynit yoo sadah yan farmoytih astooti gexkalootuh seece.
Anu dadhoyta kee qado maabitina tanim takkay immay, yi doolatih addat naqoosa le ummatta tawqem cineh.
Anu inkih tan qande kee gaaritte lih fidin badak ken kattaate.
too kaxxa bad yoo kee yi caylat alfimeh, inkih nee culteh, oson salaamah taban wak.

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
